summary: Iteration 7 regression pass after code-review fixes (empty catch blocks -> console.warn, AuthContext/ThemeContext useMemo). Backend: 66/66 pytest tests pass (43 existing + 23 new in tests/test_iteration7.py covering portfolios CRUD/isolation, alerts push/filter/ack, branding roundtrip, snapshot create + public read + 404, change-password happy/error paths, metrics polling variance, auth negatives). Frontend: Playwright verified landing (sidebar+topbar+hero, zero console output), login -> /dashboard, KPI 5s polling (77% -> 77.7% within 6.5s), onboarding tour walkthrough + LS flag, portfolio selector shows seeded 'Main Renewable Fleet', theme toggle light<->dark persisted via localStorage['gs_theme'] across reload, findings filters (search empty-state, severity chip 4->2, min-conf 97 -> 1), AI SSE streaming (assistant bubble filled <15s), AI History (16 sessions, open works), Alert Center (chips/range/search/acknowledge), Reports (Save Schedule + Save Branding both succeed and persist across reload), Change-password modal (wrong-current error + success toast, reverted), PDF export download (qa-regression-co-report-2026-08-26.pdf with branding applied), Share snapshot + /s/:token renders read-only page with gs_token removed, invalid token -> 'Snapshot not found or expired'. Happy path produced ZERO console errors and ZERO console.warns; new warns fire only when their catch branch executes (verified: garbage gs_token -> 'Auth bootstrap failed, clearing token: Invalid token' + redirect to /login + token cleared).

minor.issue: No brute-force lockout/rate limit: 6 consecutive wrong-password attempts are accepted and the 7th correct attempt succeeds. Acceptable for demo, but flagged per auth playbook.
allow_origins is hardcoded to ['*'] while backend/.env defines an unused CORS_ORIGINS key. Should read origins from env (allow_credentials is False, so no immediate security break).

Expiry is enforced only by the Mongo TTL index (expires_at, expireAfterSeconds=0); the handler itself does not compare expires_at, so a snapshot can stay readable for up to ~60s past expiry (TTL sweep interval). Cosmetic.

ui_bugs.issue: Unguarded navigator.clipboard.writeText(): when clipboard permission is denied (headless/Firefox/Safari/iframe) the promise rejects unhandled -> 'NotAllowedError: Failed to execute writeText on Clipboard' uncaught runtime error (CRA red overlay in dev), AND toast.success('Copied') still fires even though nothing was copied. Dashboard.jsx:70 already wraps the same call in try/catch - apply the same pattern to both remaining call sites.
Close (X) button for the share-link card has no data-testid.

issues: No contrast/spacing/alignment problems found; dark theme renders correctly and persists

OnboardingTour backdrop (z-50, fixed inset-0) blocks ALL interaction until Skip/Finish - correct product behaviour, but it appears 900ms after mount so automated tests must set localStorage['gs_tour_completed_v1']='1' or dismiss it first

action_items: Wrap navigator.clipboard.writeText in try/catch (Dashboard.jsx:311, Team.jsx:123) and only show the 'Copied' toast on success; show a fallback/select-text hint on failure
Add data-testid to the share-link card close button
Optional: read CORS origins from CORS_ORIGINS env var instead of hardcoded ['*']

rca_of_the_issue: Clipboard bug RCA: navigator.clipboard.writeText() returns a promise that rejects with NotAllowedError when the document lacks clipboard-write permission (headless Chromium, non-focused document, cross-origin iframe). Dashboard.jsx:311 and Team.jsx:123 call it fire-and-forget inside onClick and immediately call toast.success('Copied'), so (a) the rejection surfaces as an uncaught runtime error and (b) the user gets a false success message. Reproduce: log in, click Share, then click the copy icon in the share-link card with clipboard permission denied.
